requirements: A separate four-piece Siamese-cat armor set named Котомяф
Cream wool with chocolate ears, cuffs and paws; six dimensional whiskers; no tail
The player skin remains visible through the open face of the hood
Craft each piece from wool and fish; repair with wool
Meow on a real jump while the full set is worn
Purr while moving in crouch, not while merely holding Shift stationary
Sound instances are finite and play to their natural end, without manual stop/restart
Repeated jumps queue at most one next meow; a pending meow takes priority over starting another purr
No fall damage with a valid full set; a missing, broken or wrong-slot piece disables the bonus
Creepers and baby zombies avoid a Survival wearer within eight blocks, using pathfinding
Adult zombies remain dangerous; no immunity to lava, toxin, other attacks or void
Native armor enchantment, repair, ordinary durability and save data remain available
Remove the tail completely from the wearable geometry, item model and current Blender scene
Existing silver, steel, Magen and both sword designs are preserved

initial_balance.fear_limitations: Needs a navigable escape path. Does not disarm a creeper deliberately ignited by flint and steel.

sound_assets.delivery: One server-authoritative cue to tracking clients and wearer; finite client instances serialized per wearer
sound_assets.engine_limits: World unloading, device failure, muting or a user stopping all sounds can still stop Minecraft audio.

acceptance: Approved open-face visual A02, with the later explicitly requested tail removal in A04
Native player screenshots for wide and slim skins and normal poses
Component GameTests for real recipes, fall damage, fear targeting, repair/enchant/save and mixed sets

JAR assembled from the same runtime classes and geometry used in the accepted checks
scope: Local implementation and review artifact; no live server or owner-profile deployment is authorized by this task.
